seller_feedback.feedback_text: By far the best packaged anything I've ever purchased on eBay. Had a solid 3 inches of custom-formed padding on all sides. Shipped extremely quickly especially given the weight and size. Professionally wrapped as well as including all the little bits I needed to install drives into it. Even came with a pair of power cables. Exactly as described, worked perfectly. Seller included an email and phone number for support but I didn't have to use them since it did what it was supposed to do. 10/10.

Outstanding Ebay seller !!!!!   When  * USPS *  failed to deliver, this seller went out of his way to correct the issue. Prompt and courteous communications. Seller took corrective and decisive action. Cannot say enough good things about them. Item was in perfect condition, absolutely squeaky clean. Great price on this 4x XL710 NIC card. Came on-line first time and works great !!!!!  Thank You for your professional response !!!!!  Will do business again and highly recommend !!!!!

Clean server and arrived exactly as described. Even got a call from MKTLLC to clarify a few things and confirm I understood what was and was not included which is above and beyond if you ask me. Find many sellers will more or less respond with "too bad" if you misunderstood the posting but they went out of their way to get ahead of any possible issues.

Excellent seller! The device is top quality, just as described, in excellent condition, and offers good value and appearance. Communication was great, packaging was careful, and shipping was fast. Thank you!

The HBA330 is spotless, not a single particle of dust. I did not receive the full height bracket as pictured in the listing, but after sending a single message, I was sent the correct bracket no questions asked. They then updated listing to reflect the bracket it came with to benefit future customers. Excellent experience

An absolutely fantastic eBayer, I couldn’t be happier with the purchase and it was a great value. The item was just as described. The packaging and shipping were spectacular and extremely fast! I would buy from this eBayer again in a heartbeat! Thank you
Shipping was fast, item well packaged and as described, and items were in great condition for a fair price. A+ seller would buy again.

Item arrived quickly and in great condition.  I've never received a better packaged used product, I thought it was new!   The price is superb and the unit is great. 
I would seek this seller out again, easily.  Great seller and transaction.
